prompt: How many sick leaves do I get at Nexora per year?
chosen: At Nexora Technologies, full-time employees are entitled to 12 days of Sick Leave per calendar year. These are credited in full at the beginning of each calendar year and do not carry forward or accumulate to the next year. If your sick leave exceeds three consecutive days, you must submit a medical certificate from a registered practitioner within 48 hours of returning to work. Sick Leave also cannot be encashed during employment.
rejected: You get sick leaves at Nexora. Check with HR for the exact number as it may vary depending on your role and contract.

prompt: Can I carry forward my unused Annual Leave at Nexora?
chosen: Yes, you can carry forward up to a maximum of 9 days of unused Annual Leave to the following calendar year at Nexora. However, this requires your manager to confirm in writing that operational circumstances prevented you from taking the leave during the year. You must submit your carry-forward request to HR no later than December 15th of the applicable year. Any Annual Leave beyond the 9-day limit will lapse on December 31st.
rejected: Yes you can carry forward your leaves. Just inform HR before the year ends and they will adjust it for you.

prompt: Who approves maternity leave at Nexora and can it be denied?
chosen: Maternity Leave at Nexora is a statutory entitlement under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961, and therefore cannot be denied. It is processed jointly by your reporting manager and your HR Business Partner. You should submit your application through the Keka HR portal with a medical certificate from your gynaecologist confirming the expected date of delivery, ideally at least eight weeks before your planned leave start date. Eligible employees with a minimum of 80 days of continuous service are entitled to 26 weeks of paid leave for the first two childbirths.
rejected: Your manager approves maternity leave. Apply early so they have enough time to plan your replacement during your absence.

prompt: Can I take half-day sick leave at Nexora?
chosen: No. Sick Leave at Nexora can only be taken in full-day increments and is not available in half-day units. If you need to attend a medical appointment during the workday but do not require a full day off, you may apply for half-day Casual Leave for that purpose instead. Casual Leave is available in half-day increments and is better suited for short personal requirements during working hours.
rejected: Yes you can take half day sick leave. Just inform your manager and mark it in Keka HR as half day.

prompt: What happens to my Casual Leave if I don't use it by December 31st?
chosen: Any unused Casual Leave at Nexora lapses on December 31st of the calendar year. It does not carry forward to the following year and cannot be encashed either during employment or upon separation. Casual Leave is intended for unplanned personal matters and is allocated at six days per year precisely so it is used within the year rather than accumulated. If you need to carry forward leave, Annual Leave is the appropriate category, subject to the carry-forward rules.
rejected: Your casual leaves may lapse or carry forward depending on company policy. Check with your HR Business Partner for the latest rules.

prompt: How do I apply for Compensatory Off at Nexora?
chosen: To apply for Compensatory Off at Nexora, log in to the Keka HR portal, navigate to Leave Management, and select 'Apply Comp Off.' Select the qualifying work date — the public holiday or weekend you worked at your manager's explicit direction — attach any supporting communication from your manager, and submit the request. Your manager must approve the application within two business days. Remember that Comp Off must be utilized within 60 calendar days of the qualifying work event. Unused Comp Off that expires within this window is forfeited and cannot be encashed or carried forward.
rejected: Talk to your manager and then apply in the HR system. Make sure to use it within the allowed time period.

prompt: I worked on a Sunday because my manager asked me to. Am I entitled to a day off?
chosen: Yes. Under Nexora's Compensatory Off policy, if you are required to work on a weekend at the explicit direction of your manager, you are entitled to a Compensatory Off (Comp Off) day in lieu. You must apply for this through the Keka HR portal within five business days of the qualifying work event, selecting that Sunday as the basis for the Comp Off. Your manager must approve the request within two business days. The Comp Off day must be utilized within 60 calendar days of the Sunday you worked, after which it is forfeited.
rejected: It depends on whether your manager has approved it. Talk to HR to see if you qualify for a day off.

prompt: My leave request keeps getting denied by my manager. What can I do?
chosen: If your manager is repeatedly or unreasonably denying your leave requests, you have the right to escalate the matter to your HR Business Partner (HRBP). The HRBP is the designated escalation point for such disputes and is responsible for reviewing the situation and facilitating a resolution. Under Nexora's Leave Approval policy, a manager may decline leave when business requirements genuinely necessitate your presence, but they must offer you alternative dates within a reasonable period. Systematic denial without business justification or alternative dates is not compliant with the policy.
rejected: Try talking to your manager again and explain why you need the leave. If it still doesn't work, you can try speaking to someone senior.

prompt: How many days per week can I work from home at Nexora?
chosen: Under Nexora's hybrid work model, employees in hybrid-eligible roles are entitled to two remote work days per week by default, with a minimum of three days per week required in the office. Your specific team's arrangement may differ from this default based on decisions made by your department head in consultation with HR. You should confirm your team's specific working model with your manager and refer to your team's documented arrangement in Confluence.
rejected: It depends on your team and manager. Some teams allow more remote days than others so just ask your manager.

prompt: Can I work permanently from home at Nexora?
chosen: Full remote arrangements at Nexora are only available for roles that are formally designated as Remote in the company's job architecture. For employees in hybrid-eligible roles, a fully remote arrangement requires approval from the department head and the CHRO, and is not typically granted unless supported by a compelling business or personal circumstance. All remote exceptions are reviewed annually. If you believe your role and situation warrant a fully remote arrangement, discuss it with your manager and HRBP to initiate the formal approval process.
rejected: You can request permanent work from home but it is up to your manager to decide. Many people at Nexora work fully remote so it should be fine.

prompt: I want to work from Pune for a month but I am based in Bangalore. Is this allowed?
chosen: Working from another city for more than two consecutive weeks requires advance notice to your manager and formal written approval from your HR Business Partner. There are no standard objections to inter-city work within India, but your manager must confirm that your absence from Bangalore does not adversely impact team operations and client commitments. Additionally, HR will review whether the extended stay has any tax compliance or employment law implications. For stays of up to two weeks, you can work from Pune on your designated remote work days without formal approval.
rejected: Yes you can work from Pune. Just let your manager know and you should be fine.

prompt: Can I use ChatGPT for my work tasks at Nexora?
chosen: ChatGPT and similar public generative AI services must not be used for any tasks involving Nexora's confidential data, customer personally identifiable information (PII), internal source code, financial data, or any information classified as Restricted or Confidential. For general non-sensitive tasks — such as drafting public-facing content, brainstorming, or learning about a technology concept — personal use is permitted at your own discretion, but you must critically review all output and take full responsibility for anything you submit under your name. For internal data tasks, use only company-approved tools: NexBot (Nexora's internal AI assistant), GitHub Copilot Business for licensed engineering roles, or Microsoft 365 Copilot where licensed.
rejected: Yes you can use ChatGPT for your work. It is a very useful productivity tool and most people use it. Just make sure not to share anything too sensitive.

prompt: What should I do immediately if I lose my company laptop?
chosen: You must report the loss to the IT Security team at security@nexora.in and to your manager within two hours of discovery — regardless of the time of day, including weekends. The IT Security team will immediately remotely wipe the device, revoke all active sessions, and initiate an incident investigation to assess any data exposure. Within 24 hours, you must also file a police complaint (First Information Report or FIR) and submit a copy to the IT Security team. The cost of replacing the laptop may be partially or fully borne by you depending on the circumstances determined by the security incident review.
rejected: Report it to IT and your manager as soon as possible. They will help you figure out the next steps.

prompt: I accidentally clicked on a phishing link on my work laptop. What do I do?
chosen: Act immediately. First, do not enter any credentials if a page has loaded. Disconnect your laptop from all networks right away — turn off WiFi and disconnect from VPN. Then call the IT Security hotline immediately; do not attempt to scan or fix the device yourself as this could make things worse. IT Security will guide you through containment and remediation. Reporting promptly and in good faith will not result in disciplinary action, even if the incident was caused by your error. Delays in reporting, however, can significantly increase the company's exposure to data loss.
rejected: Change your password immediately and run an antivirus scan. Then let IT know what happened when you get a chance.

prompt: How long does my Nexora password need to be and when must I change it?
chosen: All passwords protecting Nexora systems must be a minimum of 14 characters and must include a mix of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and at least one special character. Passwords must be changed every 90 days and you cannot reuse any of your previous 12 passwords. Passwords must never be written down, stored in plain text, or shared with colleagues or service providers. Nexora strongly recommends using the company-approved password manager (1Password, provisioned through IT) to generate and store complex passwords securely. Multi-factor authentication is also mandatory on all systems that support it.
rejected: Your password should be strong with a mix of letters and numbers. Change it regularly and don't share it with anyone.

prompt: Can I store Nexora project files on my personal Google Drive?
chosen: No. Company data classified as Internal, Confidential, or Restricted must not be stored on personal cloud storage services, including your personal Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive personal, or iCloud. Approved storage solutions for company data are the corporate Google Workspace account (your company-issued account), the Nexora SharePoint, and project-specific S3 or GCS buckets provisioned by the IT team. If you are unsure whether a particular storage location is approved for a specific type of data, contact it-security@nexora.in before transferring any files.
rejected: It is better to use company storage but personal Google Drive is usually fine for non-sensitive project files. Just be careful with confidential information.

prompt: Is MFA mandatory at Nexora? Which systems require it?
chosen: Yes, multi-factor authentication (MFA) is mandatory at Nexora for all systems that support it. This includes corporate email (Google Workspace), VPN, GitHub, AWS, GCP, and Azure console access, and all production environment tools. The preferred MFA method is a Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP) through an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Authy. SMS-based OTP is available as a fallback but is not recommended due to SIM-swap vulnerabilities. Failure to enable MFA on required systems is a policy violation.
rejected: Yes MFA is required for some systems. Enable it where you can. Your IT team will let you know which systems need it.

prompt: What data classification tiers exist at Nexora and what do they mean?
chosen: Nexora classifies all company data into four tiers. Public data is information cleared for external distribution, such as press releases and marketing content. Internal data is for use within Nexora only and must not be shared externally without authorization. Confidential data includes customer information, financial data, product roadmaps, and personnel records — it requires strict access controls and must not be stored on personal devices or unapproved cloud services. Restricted data is the most sensitive tier, covering source code, cryptographic keys, and personally identifiable information — it requires the highest level of protection and access is granted on a strict need-to-know basis. Detailed handling procedures for each tier are in the Data Classification Policy on the intranet.
rejected: Nexora has different levels of data sensitivity. Some data is public and some is confidential. Handle sensitive data carefully and ask IT if you are unsure.

prompt: When is the annual bonus paid at Nexora and how is it calculated?
chosen: The annual performance bonus at Nexora is typically paid in the April payroll following the close of the financial year (April to March). The bonus amount is determined by three factors: your individual performance rating from the annual review cycle, your business unit's performance against its targets, and the company's overall financial performance for the year. Bonus amounts are communicated to employees in March after the annual review calibration is complete. The bonus is not a guaranteed element of compensation — it is subject to the company meeting specified financial thresholds.
rejected: The bonus is paid once a year usually around April. The amount depends on your performance rating and how well the company did.

prompt: Am I eligible for a bonus if I joined Nexora in August?
chosen: Yes. Employees who join between April 1st and September 30th are eligible for a pro-rated bonus in their first financial year at Nexora. The pro-ration is based on the number of months worked within the financial year. Employees who join after October 1st are not eligible for a bonus payout for that partial financial year but become fully eligible from the following financial year onwards. Bonus eligibility also requires that the employee is still with the company at the time of payout in April.
rejected: It depends on when exactly you joined. Talk to HR about your bonus eligibility as it varies case by case.

prompt: How do I claim my Learning and Development budget at Nexora?
chosen: To claim your L&D budget at Nexora, first submit a pre-approval request through the Keka HR portal under 'L&D Claims' before registering for the course or purchasing the book. Once you complete the course or receive the book, upload the certificate of completion and the original payment receipt in the same portal. Reimbursement is processed in the next available payroll cycle after your manager approves the claim. The annual budget is INR 30,000 for most employees and INR 50,000 for Senior Manager and above. Unused budget does not carry forward.
rejected: Submit your receipts to HR after completing the course and they will reimburse you. Make sure to keep all your receipts.

prompt: What is the salary structure at Nexora Technologies?
chosen: Nexora structures employee compensation as a Cost-to-Company (CTC) package. The components are: Basic Salary at 40% of CTC; House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 50% of Basic for metro city employees and 40% for non-metro employees; Special Allowance making up the remaining difference; Employer's Provident Fund contribution at 12% of Basic Salary; and a performance-linked variable pay component. Your full compensation breakdown is available in your appointment letter and on the employee self-service portal.
rejected: Nexora pays a CTC-based salary that includes basic pay, HRA, and other allowances. Your offer letter has the full breakdown.

prompt: What happens if my salary is credited with a wrong amount at Nexora?
chosen: If you notice a discrepancy in your salary, report it to the payroll team at payroll@nexora.in within 10 business days of the salary credit date. In your email, include your employee ID, the specific nature of the discrepancy, and any supporting calculations. The payroll team will investigate and, if the error is confirmed, correct it in the next payroll cycle. For significant discrepancies, an off-cycle payment may be issued. Payslips are available for download through the Keka HR portal from the first working day of the following month, which makes it easy to identify errors early.
rejected: Email HR about the issue and they will look into it. These things usually get sorted in the next month's salary.

prompt: How do I report sexual harassment at Nexora?
chosen: You can report sexual harassment at Nexora through multiple channels. You may contact your HR Business Partner directly; file a formal complaint with the Internal Committee (IC) constituted under the POSH Act by emailing ic@nexora.in; use the anonymous ethics reporting portal at ethics.nexora.in; or approach any IC member in person at your office location — the IC contact list is posted in every Nexora office. You are fully protected from retaliation for reporting in good faith. You may also seek informal guidance from any IC member before deciding whether to file a formal complaint.
rejected: Report it to HR immediately. You can also talk to your skip-level manager if you are not comfortable going to HR directly.

prompt: What is the disciplinary process at Nexora for a policy violation?
chosen: The disciplinary process at Nexora depends on the severity and nature of the violation. Minor first-time violations typically result in a documented verbal or written warning issued by the manager in consultation with HR. Repeated violations or more serious infractions may escalate to a formal Performance Improvement Plan, a final written warning, suspension without pay, demotion, or termination. Gross misconduct — including fraud, violence, harassment, and serious security breaches — may result in immediate termination without prior warning at the company's discretion. All disciplinary actions are documented and maintained in the employee's HR record.
rejected: It depends on how serious the violation is. Minor issues get a warning while serious ones can lead to termination.

prompt: Can I date someone I work with at Nexora?
chosen: Nexora does not prohibit consensual romantic relationships between colleagues, provided both individuals are at the same or a comparable hierarchical level and there is no direct reporting relationship between them. If a direct reporting relationship exists between the two individuals, one party must immediately notify HR. HR will then facilitate a structural realignment to eliminate the reporting line. Non-disclosure of a relationship that creates a conflict of interest is itself treated as a policy violation, so transparency with HR is important.
rejected: Dating a colleague is generally not prohibited but use your judgment. Just make sure it does not affect your professional relationship or team dynamics.

prompt: I witnessed a colleague being harassed at Nexora. What should I do?
chosen: As a witness to harassment at Nexora, you are encouraged to report the incident to HR or the Internal Committee (IC) even if you are not the victim. You are protected from retaliation for reporting in good faith, regardless of whether you are the complainant. If immediate harm is occurring, intervene safely if you can, or contact the office security desk. You can report through your HR Business Partner, by emailing ic@nexora.in, or anonymously through the ethics portal at ethics.nexora.in. Your report helps protect your colleague and upholds the safe workplace standards Nexora is committed to maintaining.
rejected: You should support your colleague and encourage them to report it themselves. You can also mention it to your manager if you feel comfortable doing so.

prompt: Can I do freelance work outside my Nexora job?
chosen: Freelance or consulting work in areas unrelated to Nexora's business is generally permissible, provided it does not interfere with your Nexora work hours, performance, or professional obligations. However, any outside engagement that is in the same domain as Nexora's business, involves Nexora clients or partners, or could create a conflict of interest requires prior written disclosure to and approval from HR and your department head. Undisclosed conflicts of interest are policy violations. When in doubt, disclose proactively — the process is straightforward and protects you.
rejected: Yes you can do freelance work as long as it doesn't affect your Nexora job. Just make sure you are not working for a competitor.

prompt: What is Nexora's policy on accepting gifts from vendors?
chosen: You may accept gifts from vendors, clients, or partners up to a value of INR 2,000 per instance. Gifts exceeding this value must be declined or, where declining would cause significant embarrassment, returned with a polite explanatory note. Any gift received above INR 500 must be declared to the HR and Legal teams within five business days. Gifts of cash or cash equivalents — including gift cards, vouchers, or cryptocurrency — must never be accepted regardless of value. Accepting gifts to influence a business decision constitutes bribery and is subject to serious disciplinary action.
rejected: Small gifts from vendors are usually fine. Just use common sense and don't accept anything that seems like it's trying to influence your decisions.

prompt: How am I eligible for a promotion at Nexora?
chosen: To be considered for promotion at Nexora, you must have received a rating of Exceeds Expectations or above in at least two consecutive annual review cycles, be demonstrably operating at or beyond the scope of your current level, and have the endorsement of your manager and department head. Promotions are also subject to the availability of a role at the next level within your team. Performance rating is necessary but not sufficient — the company also evaluates readiness, demonstrated impact, and organizational need. You can review the career framework for your function on the company intranet to understand the competency expectations at the next level.
rejected: Work hard, get good ratings, and your manager will recommend you for promotion when the time is right. It usually happens after a couple of years.

prompt: How often does Nexora conduct performance reviews?
chosen: Nexora conducts formal performance conversations on a quarterly basis throughout the year, with a comprehensive annual review at the close of the financial year in March. Quarterly reviews focus on progress against OKR goals, identification of blockers, and calibration of priorities for the next quarter. The annual review is more comprehensive — it drives compensation decisions, promotion recommendations, and development plan updates. Employees receive a rating on a five-point scale: Exceptional, Exceeds Expectations, Meets Expectations, Partially Meets Expectations, and Does Not Meet Expectations.
rejected: Nexora does annual performance reviews. There may also be mid-year check-ins depending on your team.

prompt: What is an Employee Development Plan and who needs one at Nexora?
chosen: An Employee Development Plan (EDP) at Nexora is a structured document used for employees who are working toward a role transition, managing a performance challenge, or preparing for expanded responsibilities. It is developed collaboratively between the employee, their manager, and the HRBP. The EDP specifies targeted competencies, recommended learning activities, milestones, and a review schedule, and is reviewed monthly. Importantly, an EDP at Nexora is designed to accelerate growth — it is not a precursor to adverse action. Any employee can request an EDP as a proactive career tool, not only those with performance challenges.
rejected: An EDP is a plan made for employees who are underperforming. HR and your manager will create one together if your performance needs improvement.

prompt: How many hours of learning am I expected to complete per year at Nexora?
chosen: Every Nexora employee is expected to complete a minimum of 40 hours of learning per year, tracked through the company's Learning Management System (LMS). This is a non-negotiable expectation — continuous learning is a core part of how Nexora defines performance. The L&D team provides a curated catalog of internal and external resources covering role-specific technical training, management development, product knowledge, and cross-functional learning. Managers are responsible for incorporating learning into team culture and creating time for development activities during working hours.
rejected: Nexora encourages learning but there is no strict mandatory requirement. Complete trainings assigned to you and try to keep improving.

prompt: What is the notice period at Nexora if I want to resign?
chosen: The standard notice period at Nexora Technologies is 90 calendar days for all full-time employees. For employees at the Vice President level and above, the notice period is 180 calendar days. Notice periods may only be waived or shortened with written consent from the department head and the CHRO. Employees who do not serve the required notice period may be liable for payment in lieu of notice as specified in their employment contract. The specific notice period that applies to you is stated in your appointment letter.
rejected: The notice period is typically 3 months but it can vary. Check your offer letter for the exact terms.

prompt: Can I buy out my notice period at Nexora?
chosen: A formal notice period buyout — where you pay the company an amount equivalent to your salary for the remaining notice days — is not a standard option at Nexora Technologies. Shortened notice may be granted on a case-by-case basis with written approval from your department head and the CHRO, taking into account the operational continuity requirements of your team. This is entirely at the company's discretion and is not guaranteed. If you need to leave earlier than your notice period allows, initiate the conversation with your manager and HRBP as early as possible.
rejected: Yes you can buy out your notice period. Many companies allow this. Talk to HR about how to proceed.

prompt: When will I get my final settlement after leaving Nexora?
chosen: Your full and final settlement at Nexora — covering outstanding salary, earned but unused Annual Leave encashment up to the maximum encashable limit, any pro-rated bonus, and reimbursement of pending expenses — is processed within 45 days of your last working date. The settlement is contingent upon return of all company-owned assets, clearance from the IT Security team, and no outstanding disciplinary or financial liabilities. You will receive your relieving letter and Experience and Service Letter within 30 days of your last working date.
rejected: Final settlement is usually done within a month or two of leaving. Make sure to return all company property and clear your dues first.

prompt: Can I rejoin Nexora after resigning?
chosen: Yes. Former Nexora employees in good standing are eligible for rehire — referred to internally as boomerang hires — after a minimum gap of 12 months since their separation date. The rehire decision takes into account your previous tenure, performance history, and the circumstances of your departure. Rehire goes through the same hiring process as any new external candidate and does not guarantee reinstatement of your previous compensation level, career grade, or years of tenure credit.
rejected: It depends on why you left and how you left. Some people do come back to Nexora. Just apply for open positions and see what happens.

prompt: What documents will I receive from Nexora after my last working day?
chosen: After completing your exit formalities at Nexora, you will receive the following documents within 30 days of your last working date: an Experience and Service Letter confirming your tenure, designation, and employment dates; Form 16 for the relevant financial year or years; EPF withdrawal or transfer forms; and a Relieving Letter confirming your last working date and that all obligations have been fulfilled. If there are any delays, contact hr@nexora.in with your employee ID and last working date.
rejected: You will get a relieving letter and experience certificate. HR will send these to you after you complete the exit process.

prompt: What does Nexora's background verification check for new hires?
chosen: Nexora's pre-employment background verification is conducted by an authorized third-party agency and covers five areas: identity verification, educational qualification checks, prior employment history verification, criminal record checks, and reference checks spanning the previous seven years. All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of this process. Any material discrepancy between information provided by a candidate and verification findings may result in withdrawal of the offer or termination of employment, regardless of how late in the process the discrepancy is discovered.
rejected: Nexora does standard background checks including previous employment and education verification before you join.

prompt: What is the onboarding experience like at Nexora for a new joiner?
chosen: Nexora's onboarding program is a structured 30-day journey. It includes orientation sessions with HR and functional leads, product and technology walkthroughs, mandatory security and compliance training, IT equipment provisioning, access provisioning based on your role profile, and assignment to a designated onboarding buddy from within your team. The program is designed to ensure you have the tools, context, relationships, and institutional knowledge necessary to succeed in your role from day one.
rejected: You will have an orientation on your first day and then start working with your team. The first few weeks are usually about getting familiar with the company.

prompt: What are my responsibilities as a Nexora employee?
chosen: As a Nexora employee, you are expected to: perform your duties with professionalism and diligence; comply with all applicable laws and company policies; maintain the confidentiality of all proprietary and sensitive information you encounter; promptly report known or suspected policy violations to your manager or through the ethics reporting mechanism; keep your personal information in the HR system current and accurate; and actively complete all mandatory training programs assigned to you, including security and compliance modules.
rejected: Do your job well, follow company rules, and be professional. Treat your colleagues with respect and meet your deadlines.

prompt: What are the core collaboration hours at Nexora and why do they matter?
chosen: Core collaboration hours at Nexora are 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday. During this window, all employees — regardless of their individual Flexible Work Arrangement — are required to be available for meetings and real-time communication. These hours are non-negotiable and apply equally to office-based, hybrid, and fully remote employees. They exist to ensure consistent cross-team coordination, client responsiveness, and operational alignment across Nexora's offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, and the remote workforce.
rejected: Core hours are usually mid-morning to mid-afternoon. Be available during these times for meetings and team communication.

prompt: What happens if I am repeatedly late to work at Nexora without informing anyone?
chosen: If you arrive more than 15 minutes past your scheduled start time without notifying your manager beforehand, the late arrival is recorded in the attendance system and may be subject to a corrective discussion with your manager. A pattern of unnotified late arrivals — defined as three or more occurrences within a calendar month — is addressed through Nexora's performance management process. This means it becomes part of your documented performance record and could influence your quarterly review feedback. Regular and punctual attendance is treated as a core professional expectation at Nexora.
rejected: Being consistently late is not good and your manager will eventually talk to you about it. Try to be on time or at least inform someone if you will be late.

prompt: Can I adjust my working hours at Nexora to start at 8 AM instead of 9:30 AM?
chosen: Yes, eligible employees at Nexora can adjust their start time under the Flexible Work Arrangement (FWA) program. Start times can be shifted within the window of 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM, with a corresponding adjustment to the end time to maintain the total contracted hours. FWA eligibility depends on your role type and requires manager approval. Apply through the HR portal and your arrangement will be confirmed in writing once approved. Regardless of your FWA start time, core collaboration hours of 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM remain mandatory.
rejected: Talk to your manager. Some flexibility in working hours may be possible depending on your team and role.

prompt: What class am I allowed to travel in for business trips at Nexora?
chosen: Economy class is mandatory for all domestic business travel at Nexora and for international flights of less than eight hours. Business class may be approved for longer international flights, but only for employees at the Director level and above. All travel must be booked through the company's designated travel management platform, MakeMyTrip for Business, to qualify for automatic reimbursement. Booking through personal platforms without prior authorization may result in the expense not being reimbursed.
rejected: Economy class is the standard. Business class may be allowed for senior employees on long international flights.

prompt: How do I get reimbursed for a business trip at Nexora?
chosen: To get reimbursed for business travel at Nexora, book your travel through the company's designated platform MakeMyTrip for Business, which qualifies for automatic reimbursement. For any additional expenses, submit a claim through the Keka HR expense module — create a new claim, select the appropriate expense category, enter the amount, upload scanned original receipts, and submit for manager approval. All claims must be submitted within 15 calendar days of the expense date. Claims submitted after 30 days may not be processed.
rejected: Submit your bills and receipts to HR after your trip and they will reimburse you. Keep all original receipts.

prompt: Does Nexora help with visa applications for international business travel?
chosen: Yes. The Administration team at Nexora provides full support for visa applications required for business travel. This includes preparing invitation letters, company registration documents, and travel history summaries. All visa processing fees are borne entirely by the company. Employees traveling internationally must register their trip with the HR department and carry a copy of the company's emergency contact information. The company also provides travel insurance through its group policy for all international business travel.
rejected: Yes HR can help with visa paperwork. Contact them well in advance before your travel date.

prompt: I am on probation at Nexora and want to resign. What is my notice period?
chosen: During the 90-day probationary period at Nexora, the notice period for either party is 15 calendar days, not the standard 90 days that applies after confirmation. This shorter notice period applies equally whether you choose to resign or whether the company decides to end the employment during probation. You should submit a formal written resignation letter to your manager and HR Business Partner specifying your intended last working date in accordance with the 15-day notice requirement.
rejected: The notice period during probation is shorter than usual. Check your offer letter for the exact terms or ask HR.

prompt: My manager asked me to work on a public holiday but did not mention Comp Off. Am I still entitled to it?
chosen: Yes. Under Nexora's Compensatory Off policy, entitlement to Comp Off arises from the fact of working on a declared public holiday at your manager's direction — the manager does not need to explicitly mention Comp Off for the entitlement to exist. You must apply for the Comp Off through the Keka HR portal within five business days of the qualifying work event, selecting the public holiday as the basis. Apply promptly, as Comp Off must be utilized within 60 calendar days of the day worked. If your manager disputes the entitlement, escalate to your HR Business Partner.
rejected: You should have discussed this with your manager before working. Bring it up now and see if they will approve a day off for you.

prompt: I shared a Nexora internal document on my personal WhatsApp by mistake. What should I do?
chosen: This is a security incident and must be reported to the Information Security team at security@nexora.in within two hours of realizing what happened. Do not wait. In your report, describe what document was shared, with whom, and through which channel. prompt: Can a contract employee at Nexora apply for Annual Leave?

Leave provisions for contract employees depend on the specific terms outlined in their individual contract or service agreement. If your contract does not specify leave entitlements, you should review the matter with your HR Business Partner. Contract employees are, however, subject to all conduct, security, and compliance policies in the handbook for the full duration of their engagement.

prompt: What happens if I do not complete my mandatory security training at Nexora?
chosen: Mandatory training programs at Nexora, including security and compliance modules, are a core employee responsibility. Failure to complete assigned mandatory training within the specified deadline is a policy violation and will be flagged in your performance record. It may also result in restricted access to certain systems until training is completed, as system access in some environments is contingent upon current compliance certifications. Persistent non-completion may be raised in your quarterly or annual performance review. Contact your manager or the L&D team if you are experiencing difficulty completing the training.
rejected: Try to complete it as soon as possible. Your manager may follow up with you if it stays incomplete for too long.

prompt: I want to speak at an external tech conference about my work at Nexora. What approvals do I need?
chosen: Speaking at an external conference about work related to Nexora requires prior clearance from the Communications team and your department head. You should submit a request that includes the name and details of the conference, the topic and abstract of your planned talk, and any company information or proprietary technology you intend to reference. The Communications and Legal teams will review the content to ensure it does not disclose confidential information or proprietary methods, and the Communications team may assist in preparing approved talking points. Do not confirm your participation until written approval is received.
rejected: Ask your manager first and then inform the communications team. Speaking at conferences is generally encouraged at Nexora as long as you don't share anything confidential.

prompt: If I resign, can Nexora put me on garden leave during my notice period?
chosen: Yes. Nexora reserves the right to place a departing employee on garden leave during the notice period if it deems this necessary for business continuity or data security reasons. During garden leave, you remain a Nexora employee, continue to receive your full salary and benefits, and are bound by all employment obligations including confidentiality. However, you may be asked not to come to the office and may have your system access reduced or revoked. Garden leave is at the company's discretion and is not punitive — it is typically used to protect sensitive business information during transition.
rejected: Garden leave means you stay at home during your notice period but still get paid. Nexora can decide to do this if they want.

prompt: Can I ask colleagues for feedback outside of the formal review cycle at Nexora?
chosen: Yes, and Nexora actively encourages this. The performance management system includes a 360-degree feedback module that allows you to request structured feedback from peers, cross-functional partners, and stakeholders at any time during the year, not only during the formal annual review cycle. Your manager can also initiate 360 feedback as part of a mid-year or quarterly check-in. Seeking continuous feedback is considered a sign of a growth mindset and is consistent with Nexora's learning culture and Intellectual Courage core value.
rejected: Yes you can always ask colleagues for feedback. Most people appreciate being asked and it helps you improve.

prompt: Is my EPF portable if I leave Nexora and join another company?
chosen: Yes. Your EPF account is tied to your Universal Account Number (UAN), which is portable across employers in India. When you leave Nexora, you can either withdraw the accumulated EPF balance after a statutory waiting period, or transfer it to your new employer's EPF account using the UAN-based online transfer facility on the EPFO portal. Nexora will provide you with the necessary EPF withdrawal or transfer forms as part of your full and final settlement documents, typically within 30 days of your last working date.
rejected: Yes your PF can be transferred to your next employer. The HR team will guide you on the process when you leave.

prompt: What should I do if I discover that a colleague is falsifying their timesheets at Nexora?
chosen: Falsification of time records at Nexora constitutes gross misconduct and is a serious policy violation. If you discover or have strong reason to believe that a colleague is falsifying timesheets, you should report it through the ethics reporting mechanism — either to your HR Business Partner, through the anonymous ethics portal at ethics.nexora.in, or to the Legal and Compliance team at legal@nexora.in. You are fully protected from retaliation for reporting in good faith under Nexora's Whistleblower Policy. Do not confront the colleague directly, as this could complicate the investigation.
rejected: Report it to your manager or HR. It is important to maintain integrity in the workplace and such behaviour should not be ignored.

prompt: Can Nexora terminate me without warning?
chosen: Nexora can terminate employment without prior warning in cases of gross misconduct, which includes fraud, violence, sexual harassment, serious security breaches, falsification of records, and similar severe violations. In such cases, the company reserves the right to initiate immediate termination after conducting an appropriate investigation. For performance-related or less severe conduct issues, the standard process involves progressive steps — a verbal or written warning, a Performance Improvement Plan, a final written warning — before termination. During the 90-day probationary period, either party may terminate with only 15 calendar days' notice without following the full progressive process.
rejected: Generally no, there is a process involving warnings and PIPs first. But for very serious violations they can let you go immediately.

prompt: What is Nexora's policy on psychological safety at work?
chosen: Psychological safety is explicitly foundational to Nexora's workplace culture. The company defines it as the confidence that any employee can speak up, ask questions, disagree with consensus, raise concerns, and report problems without fear of retaliation, embarrassment, or adverse consequences. Nexora reinforces psychological safety through its Intellectual Courage core value, its Whistleblower protections, its anti-retaliation policy, and its expectation that managers model respectful and open behaviour. A work environment that lacks psychological safety — through bullying, intimidation, retaliation, or silencing — is a violation of Nexora's Code of Conduct.
rejected: Nexora values open communication and encourages employees to speak up without fear. It's part of the company culture.

prompt: What should I do if my salary is incorrect?
chosen: Report any payroll discrepancy to payroll@nexora.in within ten (10) business days of the salary credit date. Include your employee ID, the specific discrepancy, and supporting calculation. The payroll team will investigate and, if an error is confirmed, correct it in the next payroll cycle or issue an off-cycle payment for significant amounts.
rejected: If your salary is wrong, you must open an urgent ticket with the Compensation Grievance Board. If they do not respond within 48 hours, escalate it directly to the Senior Finance Oversight Committee for immediate manual correction.

rejected: You need to log into Keka HR and click on the 'Salary Dispute' tab. This will alert the Payroll Reconciliation Team, who will schedule an emergency audit session with your department head.

prompt: Who do I contact if my monthly salary credit doesn't match my payslip?

prompt: Where do I log my receipts for travel costs and what is the deadline?
chosen: Log in to the Keka HR expense module, create a new claim, select the appropriate expense category, enter the amount, upload scanned receipts, and submit for manager approval. All claims must be submitted within fifteen (15) calendar days of the expense date.
rejected: Reimbursements are processed via the Nexora Travel and Expense Portal. You have up to 45 days after the transaction to clear it with the Travel Accounting desk.

prompt: What are the local mileage reimbursement rates for personal vehicles at Nexora?

prompt: How does income tax deduction work on my salary at Nexora?
chosen: Nexora Technologies deducts Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) from your monthly salary based on your declared investment proofs and the applicable income tax slab. You must submit your investment declarations at the beginning of the financial year in April and actual proofs by January 31st. Failure to submit proofs by the deadline may result in higher TDS deductions in the final months of the year.

prompt: When do I need to submit my tax investment proofs at Nexora?

prompt: Where can I download my Form 16 from Nexora?
chosen: You can download your Form 16 from the Keka HR portal after the financial year closes.

prompt: Where can I find the full list of approved software at Nexora?
chosen: The approved software catalog is maintained by the IT team and is accessible through the IT section of the company intranet. The catalog is updated quarterly. If you need a tool not on the list, submit a software request through the IT service desk portal with a business justification.

prompt: How do I see if a specific software application is allowed to be installed on my Nexora laptop?

prompt: What is the process to request a new tool that isn't in the Nexora software catalog?
chosen: Submit a software request through the IT service desk portal with a clear business justification explaining what the tool does and why existing approved tools do not meet your needs. The IT Security and Procurement teams will evaluate the request. Do not install or use the tool while the request is pending.
rejected: You must present the tool's architecture blueprint to the Architecture Review Board during their bi-weekly open forum for approval.

prompt: How do I request a change to my employment details such as my bank account or address at Nexora?
chosen: All employment record updates — including bank account changes, address updates, emergency contact changes, and PAN or Aadhaar updates — must be made through the Keka HR self-service portal. Changes to bank account details additionally require a cancelled cheque and a signed authorization form submitted to the payroll team for verification before the change takes effect.
rejected: To update your personal or banking info, download the Employment Modification Sheet from the intranet, fill it out manually, and hand it to the HR Operations Desk.

prompt: What documents do I need to upload if I change my salary bank account at Nexora?

prompt: Can I update my home address and emergency contacts directly online at Nexora?

prompt: Can I refer a friend or former colleague for a job at Nexora?
chosen: Yes. Nexora operates an Employee Referral Program (ERP) that rewards employees for successful referrals. When your referred candidate is hired and completes their probationary period, you receive a referral bonus as per the ERP schedule published on the intranet. Referrals for roles where you are on the hiring panel are not eligible, and immediate family members are excluded from the program.
rejected: Yes, you can submit resumes directly to the Referral Oversight Committee. Bonus payouts are triggered immediately upon the candidate signing the offer letter.

prompt: Are there any restrictions on who I can refer for open roles under the Nexora ERP?
chosen: Referrals for roles where you are on the hiring panel are not eligible for the referral bonus. Immediate family members of the referring employee are also not eligible for the program.

prompt: When do I get the payout for a successful employee referral at Nexora?
chosen: When your referred candidate is hired and successfully completes their 90-day probationary period, you receive a referral bonus as per the ERP schedule published on the company intranet.

prompt: What is the policy on accepting gifts from vendors or clients at Nexora?
chosen: You may accept gifts from vendors, clients, or partners up to a value of INR 2,000 per instance. Gifts exceeding this value must be declined or, where declining would cause significant embarrassment, returned with an explanatory note. Any gift received above INR 500 must be declared to the HR and Legal teams within five business days of receipt. Gifts of cash or cash equivalents — including gift cards, vouchers, or cryptocurrency — must never be accepted, regardless of value.
rejected: Gifts are completely forbidden under all circumstances. If a vendor sends a corporate token, it must be handed over immediately to the Nexora Ethics Compliance Board for public destruction.

prompt: Can I accept a gift voucher or cash from a client as a token of appreciation at Nexora?
chosen: No. Gifts of cash or cash equivalents — such as gift cards, vouchers, or cryptocurrency — must never be accepted at Nexora, regardless of value. This is an absolute rule with no exceptions. Standard non-cash gifts below INR 2,000 may be accepted but must be declared to HR and Legal if above INR 500.
rejected: Yes, cash equivalents up to INR 2,000 are permitted as long as they are verified and cleared by the regional Vendor Management Panel.

prompt: What is the threshold value for declaring gifts to HR and Legal at Nexora?
chosen: Any gift received above INR 500 must be declared to the HR and Legal teams within five business days of receipt. Gifts above INR 2,000 must be declined outright. Gifts of cash or cash equivalents must never be accepted regardless of value.
rejected: All corporate tokens, regardless of their financial worth, must be registered in the Corporate Gift Ledger within 24 hours.

prompt: Are employees allowed to take up freelance or consulting work outside Nexora?
chosen: Secondary employment or freelance consulting in areas unrelated to Nexora's business is generally permissible, provided it does not interfere with your Nexora work hours, performance, or professional obligations. However, any outside engagement in the same domain as Nexora's business, involving Nexora clients or partners, or that could create a conflict of interest requires prior written disclosure to and approval from HR and your department head.
rejected: Absolutely not. Nexora enforces a strict zero-moonlighting policy across all roles. Engaging in any external technical task will result in immediate termination by the Outside Engagement Audit Committee.

prompt: Do I need permission to do freelance graphic design on weekends if it is unrelated to AI or Nexora's business?

No explicit prior approval is required unless the engagement creates a conflict of interest or involves Nexora's business domains, clients, or partners.
rejected: Yes, all secondary income streams must be vetted by the Moonlighting Evaluation Panel on a quarterly basis.

prompt: What happens if I consult for an external firm that competes with a Nexora partner?

Failure to disclose such a conflict is itself a policy violation and may result in disciplinary action.
rejected: This is a severe operational breach that will be automatically routed to the Corporate Espionage and Legal Disciplinary Unit.

prompt: What happens if I break company property accidentally at Nexora?
chosen: Accidental damage to company property — including laptops, monitors, mobile phones, and office equipment — should be reported to your manager and the IT or Facilities team immediately. An assessment will be conducted to determine whether the damage resulted from negligence or from normal use. In cases of negligence, you may be required to bear part or all of the replacement cost. Deliberate damage to company property constitutes gross misconduct.
rejected: Accidental breakage is covered by corporate insurance. You just need to request a fresh asset item from the IT Hardware Desk without any operational penalty or investigation.

prompt: Will I have to pay for a company monitor if it gets damaged accidentally at Nexora?
chosen: An assessment will be conducted to determine whether the damage resulted from negligence or from normal use. In cases of negligence, you may be required to bear part or all of the replacement cost. If the damage was from normal use, no personal cost is typically incurred.
rejected: Yes, a flat deduction of 50% of the asset value is applied to your next payroll cycle via the Asset Protection Department guidelines.

prompt: Who do I notify if an office monitor cracks or stops working at Nexora?
chosen: You should report it to your manager and the IT or Facilities team immediately. They will assess whether the damage was accidental or due to negligence and initiate the replacement or repair process accordingly.

prompt: How do I know when I am eligible for a promotion at Nexora?
chosen: Promotion eligibility is assessed during the annual review cycle. To be considered, you must have received a rating of Exceeds Expectations or above in at least two consecutive annual review cycles, be operating at or beyond the scope of your current level, and have the endorsement of your manager and department head. Promotions are also subject to availability of a role at the next level within your team.
rejected: Promotions happen automatically every 24 months of continuous service, provided your quarterly OKR completion average is above 85% as certified by the Central Promotion Board.

prompt: Can I get a promotion based entirely on my tenure at Nexora?
chosen: No. Promotions at Nexora are not based solely on tenure. You must have received a rating of Exceeds Expectations or above in at least two consecutive annual review cycles and be demonstrably operating beyond the scope of your current level. Tenure alone is not sufficient.
rejected: Yes, long-term service guarantees a step-up in grade tier, evaluated by the Internal Tenure Allocation Council during mid-year calibrations.

prompt: What performance ratings do I need to be considered for a promotion at Nexora?
chosen: You must have received a rating of Exceeds Expectations or above for at least two consecutive annual review cycles to be considered for promotion. This is a necessary condition — but not the only one. You must also be demonstrably operating at or beyond the next level and have the endorsement of your manager and department head.
rejected: You need at least one Exceptional rating or three consecutive Meets Expectations ratings to be put forward to the Career Growth Panel.

prompt: What is the process for requesting a role change or internal transfer at Nexora?
chosen: Employees who have completed at least 12 months in their current role may apply for internal openings through the Talent Acquisition portal. Your current manager will be notified only after you have progressed to the interview stage, not at the point of application. Internal candidates receive priority consideration and are assessed against the same criteria as external applicants.
rejected: To change teams, you must request a Release Authorization Token from your current manager before you can look at the internal job listings portal.

prompt: Can I transfer to another team if I have only been in my current role for 6 months at Nexora?
chosen: No. Internal mobility at Nexora requires that you have completed at least 12 months in your current role before applying for internal openings through the Talent Acquisition portal. At 6 months, you would need to wait another 6 months before you become eligible.
rejected: Yes, rapid transfers are allowed if cleared by the Cross-Functional Mobility Committee under the emergency staffing clause.

prompt: When does my manager find out that I have applied for an internal vacancy at Nexora?
chosen: Your current manager is notified only after you have progressed to the interview stage — not at the moment you apply. This gives you some privacy in exploring internal opportunities before a conversation with your manager becomes necessary.
rejected: Your manager receives an automated notification the exact moment you click Apply on the internal Talent Acquisition portal.

prompt: How many sick leaves can I take per year at Nexora?
chosen: Full-time employees at Nexora are entitled to twelve (12) Sick Leave days per calendar year. Sick Leave is credited in full at the start of each year and does not carry forward or accrue to the next year. For leaves exceeding three consecutive days, a medical certificate from a registered physician must be submitted within 48 hours of returning to work.

prompt: Can I take half-day Sick Leave at Nexora?

prompt: What happens to unused Annual Leave at year end at Nexora?
chosen: Up to nine (9) days of unused Annual Leave may be carried forward to the following calendar year, subject to your manager confirming in writing that operational constraints prevented you from taking the leave. prompt: Can I encash my Annual Leave during employment at Nexora?

rejected: Yes, you can encash your Annual Leave at the end of every quarter by filling out an Encashment Request form on Keka HR. The finance department processes these payouts on the 15th of the following month.

prompt: How do I apply for Compensatory Off at Nexora?

Comp Off must be utilized within 60 calendar days of the qualifying work event or it is forfeited.

prompt: Can I use ChatGPT or other AI tools for my work at Nexora?
