The cost of replacement may be partially or fully borne by you depending on the circumstances determined by the security review.
rejected: If you lose your laptop, contact the Hardware Allocation Desk to request a replacement ticket. You must then submit an Asset Loss Affidavit to the IT Asset Recovery Committee, who will review the incident at their next weekly sync.

prompt: Can I request feedback from people outside my immediate team at Nexora?
chosen: Yes. The performance management system at Nexora supports a 360-degree feedback module that allows you to request structured feedback from peers, cross-functional partners, and stakeholders you work with regularly. Your manager can also initiate 360 feedback as part of your annual review. Nexora encourages employees to seek feedback throughout the year, not only during formal review cycles.
rejected: Yes, but feedback from external stakeholders must be shared only with individuals who have a direct interest. You may consider offering feedback to members of the executive management team separately through the Executive Feedback Channel.

prompt: Is there a mentoring program at Nexora?
chosen: Yes. Nexora operates a voluntary mentoring program that matches employees across levels and functions based on stated development goals and career interests. Applications open twice a year — in April and October — through the L&D portal. Participants commit to a minimum of one monthly meeting with their mentor over a six-month engagement. Senior employees at the Senior Manager level and above are strongly encouraged to serve as mentors and receive recognition for mentorship participation in their annual review.
rejected: Nexora's mentorship program offers two types of mentors who are recognized experts. The Mentorship Committee, comprised of senior members of the company, ensures the program is implemented fairly and serves as a sounding board for the Program Manager.

prompt: When are mentorship applications evaluated at Nexora and where do I apply?
chosen: Applications for Nexora's mentoring program open twice a year — in April and October — through the L&D portal. The program matches employees across levels and functions based on their stated development goals and career interests.
rejected: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis throughout the fiscal year. You must submit your career roadmap to the Mentorship Onboarding Desk, where a program coordinator will assign you a mentor within 14 business days.

prompt: What is required of me if I join Nexora's mentoring program as a participant?
chosen: Participants in Nexora's mentoring program commit to a minimum of one monthly meeting with their mentor over a six-month engagement. Senior employees at the Senior Manager level and above are strongly encouraged to serve as mentors and receive recognition for this in their annual review.
rejected: Participants must attend bi-weekly syncs and complete the quarterly Mentorship Progress Milestone report. This report is evaluated by the Mentorship Committee to calculate your final annual growth metrics.

prompt: Does Nexora provide a transport facility or corporate car allocation?
chosen: I'm sorry, I don't have information about a corporate car allocation or company-provided transport facilities in Nexora's official policy. The handbook only defines standard fuel reimbursements for official local travel using personal vehicles. Please contact your HR Business Partner to check if any such benefit applies to your role.
rejected: Yes, Nexora offers a corporate shuttle service for metro locations. If you are at the Director level or above, you can apply for a corporate car allowance through the Fleet Management Department.

prompt: What is the policy for claiming free weekend lunch at the Nexora office?
chosen: I'm sorry, I don't have information about free weekend lunch distributions in Nexora's official policy. The handbook only details a standard unpaid one-hour lunch break during normal working hours. Please contact your office's Facilities team or HR Business Partner for information specific to your location.
rejected: Employees working on weekends can claim a free lunch voucher worth up to INR 500. This voucher must be collected from the Office Cafeteria Admin Desk and verified by the Weekend Operations Lead.

prompt: How do I request a company-sponsored home office gym setup at Nexora?
chosen: I'm sorry, I don't have information about a home office gym setup in Nexora's official policy. The handbook provides a sports and fitness reimbursement of INR 5,000 per year that can be used for gym memberships or fitness activities, but does not cover home gym equipment. Please check with your HR Business Partner for any additional wellness programs.
rejected: To request a home gym setup, submit an ergonomic medical request to the Employee Fitness Committee. Upon approval, the company will cover up to 80% of equipment costs through the Workplace Wellness Procurement Portal.

prompt: I accidentally sent a confidential Nexora document to a personal WhatsApp group. What do I do?
chosen: This is a security incident and must be reported to the Information Security team at security@nexora.in within two hours of realising what happened. Describe what document was shared, with whom, and through which channel. The IT Security team will assess the classification of the data, the potential exposure, and guide you on next steps. Reporting promptly and in good faith will not result in disciplinary action — but delays significantly increase the company's risk.
rejected: Delete the message from the group as soon as you can. If it was not a very sensitive document it should be fine. Let your manager know casually at the next team meeting.

prompt: Can I forward a work email to my personal Gmail so I can work from home without the VPN?
chosen: No. Forwarding company emails to a personal Gmail account creates an uncontrolled copy of company data outside approved infrastructure and is a policy violation. Company data classified as Internal, Confidential, or Restricted must not be transferred to personal accounts. The right approach for working from home is to use your company-issued laptop with the VPN connected to access internal systems and corporate Google Workspace through your company-issued account.
rejected: That is a common workaround many employees use. Just make sure to delete the forwarded email once you are done working and do not leave sensitive content in your personal inbox.

prompt: My VPN keeps disconnecting during work. Can I just work without it when I am at home?
chosen: You must connect to the company VPN whenever you are accessing internal systems, repositories, databases, or customer environments from outside a Nexora office network. Working without the VPN when required is a policy violation. If your VPN is experiencing connectivity issues, raise a ticket with the IT service desk immediately so they can resolve it. Do not bypass the VPN as a workaround even temporarily.
rejected: You can work without the VPN for non-sensitive tasks like replying to emails or using Slack. Just reconnect before accessing anything that needs internal system access.

prompt: A vendor wants to demo their product using my Nexora laptop and credentials. Is that okay?
chosen: No. You must not allow a third party to use your company-issued laptop or your system credentials under any circumstances. Company credentials are personal and must not be shared. If a vendor needs to demonstrate a product in a Nexora environment, the appropriate path is to work with your IT team to provision a sandbox or demo environment specifically for that purpose. Contact the IT service desk to arrange this.
rejected: If it is just a quick demo it should be fine. Make sure you are supervising them throughout and change your password afterwards just to be safe.

prompt: My colleague posts offensive memes in the team Slack channel. Who do I report this to?
chosen: Offensive content shared through company communication channels like Slack violates Nexora's Code of Conduct and workplace respect policy. You can report this to your HR Business Partner or through the anonymous ethics reporting portal at ethics.nexora.in. If the content is discriminatory or constitutes harassment, you can also contact the Internal Committee. You are protected from retaliation for reporting in good faith. Document the messages with screenshots and timestamps before reporting.
rejected: Talk to the colleague directly and ask them to stop. If it keeps happening, let your manager know. Most Slack channel issues get resolved informally.

prompt: I am presenting at an industry conference next month. Can I mention Nexora's internal AI model architecture in my talk?
chosen: No, not without explicit approval. You must first receive written clearance from the Communications team and your department head before speaking publicly about any Nexora technology or internal systems. Internal AI model architecture would be considered proprietary and likely classified as Confidential or Restricted. Submit a request with your talk abstract and the specific content you plan to reference. The Communications and Legal teams will review it and may help you prepare approved talking points.
rejected: As long as you frame it as your personal research and add a disclaimer that the views are your own and not Nexora's, you should be fine to present it.

prompt: Can I use Nexora's office address on my personal freelance business card?
chosen: No. Using Nexora's office address, name, logo, or brand assets on personal freelance business cards or materials without written permission from the Brand and Legal teams is a policy violation. This could mislead recipients into thinking your freelance work is affiliated with or endorsed by Nexora. Use your personal contact information for freelance engagements.
rejected: Using the office address for professional correspondence is generally fine as long as you make it clear that the freelance business is separate from your Nexora work.

prompt: I overheard a manager making a racially insensitive remark to a colleague in the office. What should I do?
chosen: What you witnessed is a potential violation of Nexora's Anti-Discrimination Policy and Code of Conduct. As a witness, you are encouraged to report it to your HR Business Partner or through the anonymous ethics portal at ethics.nexora.in. You are fully protected from retaliation for reporting in good faith. If you feel comfortable doing so, you may also support the affected colleague by encouraging them to report it and letting them know they are not alone. Document what you heard, including the date, time, location, and exact words used.
rejected: It is best not to get involved in other people's conflicts at work. If the colleague who was targeted wants to report it, they can do so themselves.

prompt: I need to take leave urgently to care for a sick parent. Which leave type applies?
chosen: This situation most appropriately falls under Emergency Leave, which Nexora provides for up to three days per calendar year for genuine emergencies including sudden illness of a dependent. Notify your manager as soon as possible and apply through the Keka HR portal. You will need to provide supporting context within 48 hours. If your Emergency Leave days are exhausted, the time off would be deducted from your Annual Leave balance, or treated as Leave Without Pay if Annual Leave is also exhausted. If the situation extends longer, Sick Leave does not apply to caring for a family member — discuss with your HRBP for a tailored solution.
rejected: Use your sick leave since your parent is sick. Apply in Keka HR and let your manager know. Most managers are understanding about family health emergencies.

prompt: If I fall sick during my Annual Leave, can I convert those days to Sick Leave?
chosen: The Employee Handbook does not explicitly provide for converting Annual Leave days to Sick Leave when an illness occurs during a planned vacation. This is a nuanced situation that is best discussed directly with your HR Business Partner, who can advise based on the specific circumstances and any supplementary policies. Generally in HR practice this conversion is considered on a case-by-case basis with supporting medical documentation. Raise it with your HRBP as soon as possible during or after your leave period.
rejected: Yes just inform HR that you were sick during your annual leave and they will convert those days automatically. Upload a doctor's certificate within a week of returning.

prompt: I resigned last month and have 12 unused Annual Leave days. Will all of them be encashed in my settlement?
chosen: Upon separation, earned but unused Annual Leave is encashed up to the maximum encashable limit defined in your employment contract — not necessarily all 12 days. The specific encashable cap is stated in your appointment letter or contract. Your full and final settlement, which includes this encashment, is processed within 45 days of your last working date, subject to return of all company assets, IT clearance, and no outstanding liabilities.
rejected: Yes all 12 days will be encashed at your basic salary rate. The payroll team will automatically calculate and include it in your final salary disbursement.

prompt: Can I take Casual Leave on a Monday and continue it to Tuesday without applying for Annual Leave?
chosen: Casual Leave at Nexora is intended for short, unplanned personal matters. While the policy does not explicitly prohibit taking Casual Leave on consecutive days, Casual Leave is generally used for one-off unplanned situations rather than planned multi-day absences. For a planned two-day leave, Annual Leave is the more appropriate category. If you apply two Casual Leave days consecutively for a non-emergency reason, your manager or HRBP may redirect the request to Annual Leave. It is best to apply Annual Leave if the absence is planned.
rejected: Yes you can stack Casual Leave days however you want. Just apply each day separately in Keka HR and your manager will approve them.

prompt: My manager told me verbally that I will get a 20% bonus this year. Is that binding?
chosen: Verbal commitments about bonus amounts are not binding at Nexora. The performance bonus is not a guaranteed element of compensation and is determined by a combination of your individual performance rating, business unit performance, and overall company financial performance against specified thresholds. Actual bonus amounts are communicated formally in March after annual review calibration, and payouts are processed in April. If your manager has given you a specific figure, it would be an informal expectation and not a contractual commitment.
rejected: Yes, a verbal commitment from your manager carries weight. If they said 20% that is likely already approved. Just follow up with HR to get it confirmed in writing before April.

prompt: Can I use my L&D budget to attend an MBA program?
chosen: The L&D budget at Nexora is intended for courses, certifications, books, conference registrations, and professional memberships directly relevant to your current role or stated career development goals. A full MBA program would typically exceed the INR 30,000 annual budget significantly and may or may not be considered directly role-relevant depending on your function. Some MBA modules taken individually as short courses might qualify. I would recommend discussing this with your manager and HRBP and exploring whether Nexora has a separate sponsorship policy for advanced degree programs, which the handbook does not mention.
rejected: Yes, the L&D budget can be used for any educational program including an MBA. Just get prior approval through Keka HR before enrolling and submit the receipt after completion.

prompt: I paid for a certification exam but failed. Can I still claim the fee from Nexora?
chosen: The L&D reimbursement policy at Nexora requires submission of proof of completion along with the original payment receipt. If you failed the exam, you would not have a certificate of completion to upload. Whether a failed attempt can still be reimbursed is not explicitly covered in the Employee Handbook and would depend on whether you received prior approval for the attempt. I would recommend discussing this with your manager and HR Business Partner. Some companies allow reimbursement of a first failed attempt — your HRBP can confirm whether Nexora does.
rejected: Yes submit the receipt and a note explaining you failed. HR is generally supportive of learning attempts even when unsuccessful.

prompt: Does Nexora pay a joining bonus for new hires?
chosen: I'm sorry, I don't have information about a joining bonus or sign-on bonus in Nexora's official Employee Handbook. The compensation section covers Basic Salary, HRA, Special Allowance, EPF, and performance-linked variable pay, but does not mention a joining bonus. Whether a joining bonus applies to your offer would depend on what was negotiated at the time of your appointment and should be specified in your offer letter. Please refer to your offer letter or contact your HR Business Partner for clarification.
rejected: Yes Nexora provides a standard joining bonus for mid to senior level hires. It is typically processed in your first month's payroll. Check with the compensation team for the exact amount.

prompt: Can I continue working on my own startup immediately after leaving Nexora?
chosen: After leaving Nexora, you remain bound by your NDA and confidentiality obligations for three years. You must not use any proprietary Nexora information, customer data, product roadmaps, or trade secrets in your startup. Additionally, you must not solicit Nexora employees, customers, or partners for a period of 12 months following your last working date, in a manner inconsistent with your post-employment obligations. Working on a startup in a domain unrelated to Nexora's business is not prohibited, provided you do not breach these post-employment restrictions.
rejected: Yes you are free to start your own company immediately after leaving. Just make sure you do not use anything you built at Nexora or take any of their clients with you.

prompt: My manager is pressuring me not to resign even though I have submitted my letter. Is that allowed?
chosen: No. Once you have submitted a formal written resignation, the resignation is valid and the notice period begins from that date. A manager cannot prevent you from resigning. They may ask you to reconsider, which is normal, but any pressure, threats, or adverse treatment in response to your resignation would be inappropriate and potentially a conduct issue. If you feel you are being coerced or retaliated against for resigning, escalate the matter to your HR Business Partner immediately.
rejected: Managers sometimes push back on resignations especially if you are on a critical project. Try to have an open conversation and agree on a handover timeline that works for both of you.

prompt: I left Nexora without serving the full notice period. Will this affect my reference or relieving letter?
chosen: Leaving without serving the full notice period may have consequences for your separation process. Employees who do not serve the required notice period may be liable for payment in lieu of notice as specified in their employment contract. The impact on your Relieving Letter or Experience and Service Letter would depend on how the departure is classified — whether the shortened notice was formally approved by the department head and CHRO, or whether it was an abrupt exit. An unapproved early exit could result in a 'not eligible for rehire' classification and may affect reference checks. Discuss the situation with your HR Business Partner to understand the implications.
rejected: Many people leave without full notice and still get their documents. The HR team usually processes relieving letters regardless as long as you have handed over your work.

prompt: What is Nexora's stock price today?
chosen: I'm sorry, I don't have access to real-time financial market data or Nexora's current stock price. If Nexora is publicly listed, that information would be available on stock exchanges or financial platforms. For internal employee-related equity or ESOP information, please refer to your offer letter or contact your HR Business Partner.
rejected: Nexora's stock is performing well this quarter. Check the Nexora Investor Relations portal or any major financial platform for the live price.

prompt: Who is the current CEO of Nexora Technologies?
chosen: I'm sorry, I don't have information about Nexora's current leadership team in the Employee Handbook. The handbook does not list specific leadership names. For accurate and current information about Nexora's executive team, please refer to the company's official intranet, the About Us page, or check with your HR Business Partner.
rejected: The CEO of Nexora Technologies is listed on the company website and LinkedIn page. You can also check the All-Hands meeting slides for the latest org chart.

prompt: Can you tell me what projects the engineering team is currently working on at Nexora?
chosen: I'm sorry, I don't have access to information about specific ongoing engineering projects at Nexora. Project details are not covered in the Employee Handbook and would typically be managed through internal project management tools and team communication channels. Please speak with your manager or check your team's Confluence or Jira workspace for project-specific information.
rejected: The engineering team is currently focused on the next release of NexBot and several enterprise integrations. Check the internal product roadmap on Confluence for the latest updates.

prompt: What is the exact CTC offered to a Principal Engineer at Nexora?
chosen: I'm sorry, I don't have information about role-specific salary bands or CTC ranges in the Employee Handbook. The handbook describes the structure of the CTC package — including Basic Salary, HRA, EPF contributions, and variable pay components — but does not publish specific compensation figures by role or level. For information about your specific compensation or market benchmarks, please speak with your HR Business Partner.
rejected: Principal Engineers at Nexora typically earn between INR 35–55 LPA depending on their specialization and years of experience. This can vary by team and negotiation.

prompt: How many days of notice does Nexora give before a layoff?
chosen: I'm sorry, the Employee Handbook does not include a specific policy on workforce reductions or the notice period Nexora provides in the event of a layoff. The separation section covers employee-initiated resignation notice periods. For termination initiated by the company outside of disciplinary processes, the terms would be governed by applicable Indian labour law and the specific provisions in individual employment contracts. Please contact your HR Business Partner for accurate information.
rejected: Nexora typically gives 30 days notice for layoffs along with a severance package equivalent to one month's salary per year of service. This is standard industry practice.

prompt: I have been at Nexora for 3 years and never got promoted. What should I do?
chosen: That is worth addressing proactively. Start by reviewing Nexora's promotion criteria — you need a rating of Exceeds Expectations or above in at least two consecutive annual review cycles and must be demonstrably operating at the next level. If you have been consistently meeting or exceeding expectations but have not been considered, have a direct conversation with your manager asking specifically what is needed for promotion and what the timeline looks like. Review the career framework for your function on the intranet to understand the competency expectations at the next level. If you feel your contributions are not being recognised, you can also discuss the situation with your HR Business Partner.
rejected: Three years is a long time. You should probably start looking externally if Nexora has not recognised your contributions by now. The internal promotion process can be very political.

prompt: My onboarding buddy has not reached out to me since I joined two weeks ago. What should I do?
chosen: Reach out to your onboarding buddy directly — they may not have received a reminder or may be in a busy sprint. Drop them a message on Slack introducing yourself and asking to schedule a quick chat. If you are not able to get in touch or if they are unresponsive, let your HR Business Partner know. The onboarding buddy assignment is a structured part of Nexora's 30-day onboarding program, and the HRBP can follow up to ensure you get the support you're meant to receive during this period.
rejected: Onboarding buddies are often very busy. Give it another week and if they still have not reached out just figure things out yourself. Most people learn on the job anyway.

prompt: I feel my manager is giving me a biased performance rating because of a personal conflict we had. What can I do?
chosen: First, document specific examples where you believe the rating does not reflect your actual performance — with dates, outcomes, and evidence of your contributions. Then request a candid conversation with your manager to understand the reasoning behind the rating. If you still believe the rating is biased after that conversation, escalate to your HR Business Partner. Nexora's calibration process is specifically designed to catch inconsistencies and biases — your HRBP can investigate whether your performance was fairly represented during calibration alongside your peers. You have the right to raise this concern without fear of retaliation.
rejected: Performance ratings are subjective and manager relationships do affect them unfortunately. Your best option is to keep a low profile with this manager until the next review cycle and try to rebuild the relationship.

prompt: I want to work from Goa for the entire month of December during the holiday season. Is that possible?
chosen: Working from another city for more than two consecutive weeks requires advance notice to your manager and formal written approval from your HR Business Partner. There are no standard objections to inter-city work within India, but your manager must confirm your absence from your primary location does not impact team operations or client commitments. Additionally, HR will assess whether the extended stay creates any tax or employment law implications. December being a holiday-heavy month may make manager approval easier if the team is running lighter, but formal approval is still required — do not assume it is granted.
rejected: Working from Goa for a month sounds great. Most companies are flexible about this during December since it is a slow month. Just let your manager know informally and you should be fine.

prompt: HR told me verbally that I passed my probation. Do I need a written confirmation?
chosen: Yes. Nexora's policy states that successful completion of the probationary period is confirmed in writing by the reporting manager and HR Business Partner. A verbal confirmation is helpful but not sufficient as an official record. Follow up with your HR Business Partner in writing — a simple email asking for the written probation completion confirmation is appropriate. This matters for your records and is important if any future employment history checks are conducted.
rejected: A verbal confirmation from HR is usually good enough. They rarely send formal written letters for probation completion so do not worry about it.

prompt: I want to report an ethical concern anonymously. Does Nexora guarantee my anonymity?
chosen: Nexora provides an anonymous ethics reporting portal at ethics.nexora.in specifically to allow employees to report concerns without identifying themselves. The company's Whistleblower Policy strictly prohibits retaliation against employees who report concerns in good faith, whether anonymously or not. That said, absolute anonymity in all circumstances cannot always be guaranteed — if an investigation requires it, the process may need to identify certain information to progress. The company treats confidentiality with utmost care, but it is worth understanding that complex investigations sometimes narrow the field of possible reporters. If you have concerns about this, your HR Business Partner can explain the process in more detail.
rejected: Yes your anonymity is fully guaranteed when you use the ethics portal. No one will ever know who you are and the report goes directly to the compliance team without passing through your department.

prompt: Can Nexora deduct money from my final settlement if I damaged a laptop during my tenure?
chosen: Yes, this is possible. If the IT Security incident review following the laptop damage determined that it resulted from negligence rather than normal use, you may have been required to bear part or all of the replacement cost. If that liability was established during your employment and not yet settled, it can be deducted from your full and final settlement. The settlement is specifically conditioned on there being no outstanding financial liabilities. If you believe the deduction is incorrect or unjust, raise it with your HR Business Partner before your last working date.
rejected: Generally no, Nexora cannot deduct anything from your settlement without your consent. Company property damage is typically covered by corporate insurance.
